title: After Totalitarianism: Museum, Memory and the Belarusian Perspective
description: An international academic and practical conference on museums, the memory of repression and the reassessment of authoritarian legacies.
body:
Organised by the Free Belarus Museum, the conference brought museum professionals and researchers together to discuss historical memory and the Belarusian perspective.
